name: RecordNews
description: A news post: date, optional byline and category, an excerpt for list cards, and its own page at /news/<slug> — a typed header above a free content body that accepts any active Content Block.
when_to_use: Company news, project updates, press releases. One record per post. List them with a RecordList (newest first) or a Teaser when the section needs a specific layout.
capabilities: date-driven ordering, with an author byline and a category for filtering
excerpt feeding both the list card and the SEO description fallback
hero image for the card and the page header, plus a gallery on the page
content_elements: the post body — any active Content Block, rendered like a page's content

ai.prompt_summary: News record (tx_factorycore_record_news, type slug 'news'): title (required), slug (required, auto from title — the URL segment in /news/<slug>), excerpt (1-2 sentences, list card + SEO description fallback), date (required, display date and sort key), author (optional byline), category (company|projects|press|events), hero_image (array of one file), gallery (max 30), content_elements (the body — any block). These identifiers match what the guided news flow already writes into records.meta.
ai.content_guidelines: Headline-style titles, not sentences, and no trailing period. Excerpt 1-2 sentences that make sense out of context, since it appears on cards. Set date to the publication date, not today, when back-filling. Leave author empty rather than inventing one.

field_hints.date: ISO 8601 (2026-07-14). Lists sort on it, so a wrong date silently reorders the news page.
field_hints.excerpt: Shown on the card and used as the SEO description when none is set — write it to stand alone.
field_hints.hero_image: An ARRAY of one file object, even though only one image is used.
field_hints.content_elements: The post body. Any active Content Block, rendered by FactoryPageRenderer below the typed header.
